Name: (CP) Combination Table
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3][quote]This mod is a conversion and modification to the CP version of a mod that was previously released as a mod that works with DGA. ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18395]Repealed DGA version[/url]﻿)[/quote]
The tables added by this mod are divided into "left/right", " up/down", and " center".
The length can be freely changed by adjusting the number of tables placed in the middle.
Also, each functions as a single table, so you can put things on each.

Some desks do not have a middle part.
[/size][size=3]These were originally 2x2 tables in vanilla, but have been changed to 2x1, which is a bonus.

A one-tile table of a different type than vanilla will also be added.

Robin will sell a catalog specifically for the tables added by this mod.
Even early in the game, Robin sells only oak tables for “trial use”.
[/size]

Currently, English and Japanese are supported.
